commit.message:
Plan three benchmark follow-ups: solver comparison, data download, DuckDB post

tasks/bench-solver-compare: compare an algorithm's published results with another
solver on the page, without downloading anything. Records the honesty rules the
join has to extend — align by instance without zero-filling, like-for-like configs
(branch_bound's budget vs exact), two families means two budgets, spread stays
visible, per-solver provenance, one axis rule for the pair.

tasks/bench-data-download: offer the shard the page is rendering, plus the manifest
and the release snapshots. Records that cross-origin `download` is ignored, so the
label has to match what a browser actually does.

tasks/blog-benchmarks-duckdb: a reproducible walkthrough, with the recipe verified
against the live tree — single shards read over HTTPS, globs over HTTP do not, and
the two unnest shapes that turn a shard into a table.
